snippet.title: The iPhone That Bent in Your Pocket
snippet.description:
When Apple launched the iPhone 6 in 2014, it introduced a larger display and an incredibly thin aluminum body. Not long after release, users began sharing photos of phones that had slightly bent after being carried in their pockets. The internet quickly gave the controversy a name: "Bendgate."

While later testing showed it took significant force to permanently bend the phone, the viral photos and videos turned Bendgate into one of the biggest product controversies in smartphone history.
